overview: Lesotho is a small landlocked kingdom completely surrounded by South Africa. Its capital and largest city is Maseru. Lesotho became independent from the United Kingdom in 1966. Sesotho and English are its official languages, and many people wear the traditional Basotho blanket and hat.

geography.text: Lesotho is the only country in the world that lies entirely above 1,000 metres, which has earned it the nickname 'Kingdom in the Sky'. Much of it is in the Maloti and Drakensberg mountains, and its highlands supply water to South Africa through large dams and tunnels.
